# Getting help

- **Setup and how-to questions:** start with the [guides](https://tandemcrm.dev/guides/getting-started/). If they do not answer it, open an issue with the "question" label so the answer is public for the next person.
- **Something is broken:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/angkutdigital/tandem-crm/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Your Postgres host:** tell us how Tandem worked on it with a [host report](https://github.com/angkutdigital/tandem-crm/issues/new?template=host_report.yml).
- **A security problem:** do not open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Tandem is an early open source project and we answer when we can. We read everything.
